newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait names new oil minister.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait names new oil minister.

text.p: OPEC heavyweight Kuwait Tuesday appointed a new oil minister in a 14-man cabinet, an official decree said.

U.S.-educated Issa Mazeedi, a member of Kuwait's minority Shi'ite branch of Islam, has a masters degree in business administration and a bachelors in industrial engineering, a Kuwaiti politician said.
Mazeedi is in charge of Kuwait's main revenue earner. Kuwait currently produces about two million barrels a day.
Born in 1942, he is a former elected member of parliament in 1981 and a former communications minister.

He replaces Abdul-Mohsen al-Mudej who resigned in September to seek re-election in last week's parliamentary polls. Mudej is one of several elected deputies who was received by Crown Prince and Prime Minister Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah ahead of the formation of the new cabinet.
Some political sources and newspapers said that Mudej had apparently expressed a wish not to be included in the new government.
